{{Quote|Hear me people of Iziz! ''Freedon Nadd'' gave this city strength against the wild men and their beasts&mdash;as long as ''King Ommin'' and ''Queen Amanoa'' carried on that noble rule&hellip;the great power of Freedon Nadd remained with us!''"<br />"''Now that power has been ''taken'' from us by the hateful Jedi Knights. These meddlers have destroyed the ancient Onderon society!|Naddist propaganda spread by [[Rask]] and [[Nebo]]|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''Naddists''' were a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] that worshiped the fallen [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Freedon Nadd]]. They built the [[Proving Grounds|Ancient Proving Grounds]] for trials where competitors would fight to the death to curry favor with the Dark Lord.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Ancient Proving Grounds}}</ref> Many of them were capable of using ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magic]]. Two such individuals were King [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] and his wife Queen [[Amanoa]]. They were largely eliminated following the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]].
